I was walking inside a trail adjacent to Mandiyaco River, near to PNN Churumbelos, far away I heard the song and I walk slowly to find the bird, after that, I heard a couple singing inside of montane forest during one minute, (The recording was made with my digital camera).
I and other partners are writing a paper of this record for Colombia, also,  we believe that according to http://www.museum.lsu.edu/~Remsen/SACCprop617.htm this taxon was elevated to species level: Nystalus obamai, and xenocanto should follow this split.
